title: Improvement of works in connection with promotion of tourism at Portonova Lighthouse
summary: E-tender for civil and electrical improvement works to promote tourism at Portonova (Porto Novo) Lighthouse, Cuddalore District, Tamil Nadu, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Portonova Lighthouse, Cuddalore District, Tamilnadu
sites.work: Improvement works (civil and electrical) for promotion of tourism

scope.item: Improvement of works in connection with promotion of tourism - Civil
Improvement of works in connection with promotion of tourism - Electrical

money.notes: Estimated cost Rs 50,24,893 including 18% GST: Civil Rs 45,67,143; Electrical Rs 4,57,750. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai payable at Chennai, valid three months from technical bid opening. Tender fee 'as per NIT' by DD, but no amount printed.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category & class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies

Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80%; only fully completed works with completion certificate; values enhanced at 7% simple per annum; certificates below Executive Engineer rank not considered
Similar works: repairs and civil maintenance of building or construction of any type of building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC work
PAN/ITCC/GST registration; key technical personnel for supervision and execution
Unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III); tender acceptance letter (Annexure II); affidavit/self-attestation of not being blacklisted
List of relatives serving in MoPSW/DGLL; Make in India self-certification (Annexure VI)
notes: Scanned Section-I NIT only; no BOQ. NIT table skips serial number 12. No turnover criterion printed. Download/bid submission period 10.10.2025 10:00 to 27.10.2025 15:00; opening 28.10.2025 15:00.
